verdict.rationale: A probe confirms rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200, showing agent-oriented docs exist for the ROCm ecosystem tied to Radeon GPU support, but this is a general ROCm docs file rather than something specific to the RX 9070 XT product page itself, and no OpenAPI/agent-tool spec is available (all candidates 404). missing for 10: a dedicated llms.txt or agent doc for the RX 9070 XT product page itself, machine-readable API/tool spec (openapi.json), and independent confirmation that agents can successfully consume/act on the llms.txt content.
